name: Yi Weihua
current_role: Co-founder and controlling shareholder, WG Tech (Jiangxi WG Optoelectronic, 603773.SH); stepped down as chairman and director in March 2026
profile: Yi Weihua (易伟华) co-founded WG Tech (沃格光电) in Xinyu, Jiangxi in December 2009 with Zhang Fujia. It started in flat-panel display glass processing, listed on the Shanghai main board in 2018, and is now pivoting to glass circuit boards (GCP) for Mini LED and semiconductor packaging. He left the board in March 2026 'for personal reasons', and Zhang Chunjiao became chairman.
interesting_fact: Yi has a technical background, and since 2019 he has personally led WG Tech's R&D push into glass-substrate circuit boards (TGV/GCP) for Mini LED backlights and advanced chip packaging. That puts the company in the glass-core substrate race relevant to AI and data-center chips.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from university in 1996, Yi started as a technician in Shenzhen and rose to manager and trader. In 2006 he started his own touch-screen sales business before founding WG Tech. He has said he wanted to 'gather a group of young people with dreams, character and ability to come together to do things that are meaningful to society.'
notes: No longer chairman (resigned March 2026); Zhang Chunjiao (listed as sharing this wealth entry) is now chairman. In May 2026 the CSRC opened an investigation into a share-transfer disclosure, and he was fined in August 2026. Treat as sensitive and approach via company IR.

name: Telis Mistakidis
current_role: Private investor (Zug-based): controlling shareholder of Aegean Baltic Bank, shipping investor, owner of PAOK BC via Alpha Sports Group
profile: Aristotelis 'Telis' Mistakidis is a Greek-British metals trader who joined Marc Rich & Co (later Glencore) in 1993 and ran its global copper business. He became a billionaire with Glencore's 2011 IPO, when he held about 6%, and left at the end of 2018. Since then he has invested in Greek banking (Piraeus Bank stake, control of Aegean Baltic Bank), shipping (Union Maritime) and real estate.
interesting_fact: In 2025 his Alpha Sports Group agreed to buy a majority stake in PAOK BC, the Thessaloniki basketball club. In May 2026 PAOK announced a new basketball training centre in Pylaia.
deep_cut_fact: He was born in Rome in 1961, where his father, a marine biologist, worked for the United Nations. He graduated in economics from the LSE and spent six years trading non-ferrous metals at Cargill before joining Marc Rich & Co's zinc and lead desk in March 1993.
notes: Very private, with no personal public channels found. Avoid the topic of his 2018 Glencore exit (the Katanga Mining accounting case in Ontario). Possible routes are via Aegean Baltic Bank or PAOK BC. Forbes 2026 put his net worth at about US$4.2bn, well above the 2020 Sunday Times figure.

name: Jared Isaacman
current_role: 15th Administrator of NASA (since Dec 18, 2025); largest shareholder of Shift4 Payments
profile: Isaacman founded what became Shift4 Payments at 16 in 1999 and took it public in 2020; he also co-founded Draken International. He commanded the SpaceX missions Inspiration4 (2021) and Polaris Dawn (2024). He left Shift4's board after the Senate confirmed him as NASA Administrator in Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: He is a fighter-jet pilot (call sign 'Rook') who bought a Soviet MiG-29 from Paul Allen's estate. As commander of Polaris Dawn in 2024 he made the first commercial spacewalk.
deep_cut_fact: In 2009, on his second attempt, he set the record for flying around the world in a light jet: 61 hours, 51 minutes and 15 seconds, about 20 hours faster than the previous record. He also left high school at 16, earned a GED, and later got an online aeronautics degree from Embry-Riddle (2011).

public_contacts.value: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov (Deputy Press Secretary for NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman)

notes: He is a sitting US government official, so interview requests go through NASA's press office ('Leadership Interview Requests'). He is a strong fit for an energy/space podcast because of his push on nuclear propulsion and surface power.

name: Tao Chunfeng
current_role: Chairman, Ningbo Changhong Polymer Technology (长鸿高科, 605008.SH); founder and chairman, Keyuan Holding Group (科元控股)
profile: Tao Chunfeng (陶春风), from Shengzhou, Zhejiang, trained in petrochemicals and worked at Sinopec Zhenhai Refining before co-founding Ningbo Keyuan Plastic. His listed Changhong Polymer makes styrenic thermoplastic elastomers (TPES). In 2024 it began trial output at a 600,000-tonne transparent ABS/polymer project in Guangxi. He is a Zhejiang provincial people's deputy.
interesting_fact: He holds more than 95 invention and utility-model patents. After seeing farmers in Qingyang, Gansu struggle to clear plastic mulch film, he launched the 'Spring Forest Plan' (春林计划) with 1,000 mu of demonstration land for degradable mulch.
deep_cut_fact: In his first two years after graduating, at Sinopec's Zhenhai Refining & Chemical, he won more than 30 technical innovation and management awards. He also funds an education fund at Zhenhai High School's Shengzhou campus in his hometown.

public_contacts.value: bh@kygroup.ltd (board secretary Bai Hua, Changhong Polymer)

notes: The input lists 'Changhong' as the source of wealth; this is Ningbo Changhong Polymer (长鸿高科), not Sichuan Changhong Electric. His energy angle is petrochemical feedstocks and polymer materials.

name: Sun Weimin
current_role: Vice chairman of Suning Holdings Group (per Suning Easybuy filings); chaired Suning.com's supervisory board 2023 to Dec 2025
profile: Sun Weimin (孙为民) is a longtime Suning executive. He joined Suning Appliance in 1998 as assistant to the general manager and rose to president and vice chairman, sharing in its growth into China's largest electronics retailer. He left the Suning.com board in 2021 and then chaired its supervisory board until the body was dissolved at the end of 2025.
interesting_fact: Before retail, he was an academic. He studied psychology at Beijing Normal University (1981–1988) to master's level, then taught at Nanjing University of Science and Technology for a decade.
deep_cut_fact: He was born in Xinjiang in 1963. He made the jump from a university lecturer's post to Suning in 1998, starting as assistant to the general manager. In 2014 he wrote a piece arguing that physical stores should become consumer social spaces.
notes: He was last on Hurun in 2016, so his wealth is probably much reduced since Suning's troubles (don't mention). Low public profile; the route is via Suning IR. The 'current vice chairman of Suning Group' title comes from a resume aggregator and may be stale.
